summary: Phase 1 Library Repository passes acceptance. All 8 targeted RecordingStatus/ListByStatus tests pass against real SQLite. Full make go-check green (18/18 packages). No t.Skip guards, no stub blocks, no fake-harness masking. Commit SHAs in plan.md (ef7dcc0 Red, 8ead24d Green) verified. One non-blocking finding: spec FR2 names status values as New|Transcribing|Transcribed|Error but implementation uses pending|in_progress|completed|error, matching pre-existing codebase conventions (migration DEFAULT, service layer, all prior tests). Spec should be updated to reflect established convention.
findings: Spec FR2 / test-strategy §3 define status enum as New|Transcribing|Transcribed|Error, but implementation uses pending|in_progress|completed|error. Implementation is internally consistent and matches pre-existing migration DEFAULT ('pending'), RecordingService, and all existing test fixtures. Not blocking — spec drift, not a bug. Recommend updating spec FR2 and test-strategy §3 to match.
